script:
set -Eeuo pipefail
systemctl stop karpo-vllm-development-01.service || true
aws s3 cp /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/development-01/ s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/results/vllm-single-20261120/development-01/ --recursive --region us-east-1 --no-progress
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv,noheader
aws s3 cp s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/inputs/vllm-single-development-03-server.py /opt/karpo/scripts/vllm_karpo_server.py --region us-east-1 --no-progress

systemd-run --unit=karpo-vllm-development-02 --property=RuntimeMaxSec=1800 --property=StandardOutput=append:/opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/development-02/server.log --property=StandardError=inherit --setenv=OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 --setenv=TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false --setenv=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 /opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python /opt/karpo/scripts/vllm_karpo_server.py --checkpoint /opt/karpo/models/karpo-4b --output /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/development-02 --max-seqs 1
